section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants of a single study conducted at two universities in Hong Kong. The sample consisted of 2,403 students (1,319 female, 1,084 male) with a mean age of 23.52 years. BMI was assessed using self-reported height and weight, with a mean BMI of 20.75 kg/m², and the majority of participants self-reported as atheists and single.
